title: Java String Interview Questions and FAQs

sections.heading: Java String Interview Questions and FAQs
paragraphs: Below is a curated list of commonly asked Java String interview questions and FAQs. These questions are useful for freshers as well as experienced developers preparing for technical interviews.

4) How to reverse a String in Java?
paragraphs: You can reverse a string using loops, StringBuilder, or recursion. Read more

sections.heading: 5) How to check whether a String is Palindrome in Java?
paragraphs: A string is palindrome if it reads the same forward and backward. Read more

sections.heading: 6) Write a Java program to capitalize each word in a String
paragraphs: Each word’s first letter is converted to uppercase using logic or String methods. Read more

sections.heading: 7) Write a Java program to reverse each word in a String
paragraphs: Each word is reversed individually while maintaining word order. Read more

sections.heading: 8) Write a Java program to toggle each word in a String
paragraphs: Uppercase letters are converted to lowercase and vice versa. Read more

sections.heading: 9) Write a Java program to reverse and toggle each word in a String
paragraphs: Each word is reversed and character cases are toggled. Read more

sections.heading: 10) What is the difference between String and StringBuffer?
paragraphs: String is immutable, while StringBuffer is mutable and thread-safe. Read more

sections.heading: 11) What is the difference between StringBuffer and StringBuilder?
paragraphs: StringBuffer is synchronized (thread-safe), whereas StringBuilder is faster but not synchronized. Read more

sections.heading: 12) What does the intern() method do in Java?
paragraphs: The intern() method stores the string in the String Constant Pool. Read more

sections.heading: 13) How to convert String to int in Java?
paragraphs: You can use Integer.parseInt() to convert a string into an integer. Read more

sections.heading: 14) How to convert int to String in Java?
paragraphs: Use String.valueOf() or Integer.toString(). Read more

sections.heading: 15) How to convert String to Date in Java?
paragraphs: You can use SimpleDateFormat or DateTimeFormatter. Read more

sections.heading: 16) How to optimize Java String creation?
paragraphs: Use string literals, StringBuilder, and avoid unnecessary object creation. Read more

sections.heading: 17) How to check whether two Strings are anagrams?
paragraphs: Two strings are anagrams if they contain the same characters in different order. Read more

sections.heading: 18) How to find duplicate characters in a String?
paragraphs: Duplicate characters can be found using loops, HashMap, or arrays. Read more

sections.heading: 19) Why are Strings immutable in Java?
paragraphs: Immutability improves security, caching, and thread safety. Read more

sections.heading: 20) How to remove white spaces from a String?
paragraphs: Use replace() or replaceAll() methods. Read more

sections.heading: 21) Java Program to check whether one String is a rotation of another
paragraphs: One string is a rotation of another if it can be obtained by rotating the characters of the original string. Read more

sections.heading: 22) Java Program to count the number of words in a String
paragraphs: Words in a string can be counted by splitting the string using spaces or regular expressions. Read more

sections.heading: 23) Java Program to reverse a String while preserving the position of spaces
paragraphs: Characters are reversed while spaces remain at their original positions. Read more

sections.heading: 24) How to swap two String variables without using a third variable?
paragraphs: Strings can be swapped using concatenation and substring operations. Read more

sections.heading: 25) How to remove a particular character from a String?
paragraphs: You can remove a specific character using replace() or replaceAll() methods. Read more

sections.heading: 26) How to convert String to Integer and Integer to String in Java?
paragraphs: Use Integer.parseInt() for String to Integer and String.valueOf() for Integer to String conversion. Read more
